research_rationale: basis_pattern: original_plus_bounded_search. EO 10488 (signed 1953-09-23; 18 FR 5699; official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10488.txt, read in full) is a single paragraph: it orders that the purchase, custody, transfer or sale of foreign exchange by any executive department or agency be administered under regulations issued by the Secretary of the Treasury, and authorizes the Secretary to issue them. Identity: heading, title and date agree with the register row. Own terms: the order states no end date or ending condition. Later instruments: a search of the held order texts for the number 10488 finds only the order's own Federal Register copy, the 1989 codification snapshot and the held current CFR texts (31 CFR 281.1 and the part 281 authority line); no later order amends, revokes or supersedes it, and the dossier chain lists no event. Current law: the eCFR (point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 and the GovInfo bulk copy amended through 2026-10-15) prints 31 CFR 281.1 as issued under 'Executive Order No. 10488, 18 FR 5699, 3 CFR 1949-1953 Comp.' and the part 281 authority citation names E.O. 10488 beside E.O. 10900; the section 281.1 lead is confirmed at the cutoff by the point-in-time search. The U.S. Code scan (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; laws of 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected) has no note that prints or names this order. The order mentions section 1415 of the Supplemental Appropriation Act, 1953 (31 U.S.C. 724) and section 1313 of the Supplemental Appropriation Act, 1954 only as laws its regulations must not contradict, not as the authority it rests on (it rests on the Constitution and statutes and the President's office); the current Code text of those sections is not held and I do not assert how they now read. The three selected machine searches (current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog) were read with their coverage notes; none carries a coverage warning and none records a revocation or supersession of EO 10488.
savings_reason: EO 10488 has no savings, transition or accrued-rights clause, and no held instrument ends it; the current eCFR continues to print it as authority for 31 CFR part 281.
earlier_end_check: No clause has an own-terms end. No held order, statute text or search result ends, amends, revokes or supersedes EO 10488; the ofr_catalog search records no disposition note for it and a search of held order texts for the number finds no later instrument. The current CFR still prints it as authority for 31 CFR part 281.
scope_check: The held text is one operative paragraph (the title, the single ordering paragraph and the signature block); the dossier clause spans the whole ordering paragraph, so the inventory of one clause is complete.
independent_command_check: The paragraph contains one command (administration of foreign-exchange purchase, custody, transfer and sale under Treasury regulations) and one conferral of authority on the Secretary of the Treasury to issue the regulations; they stand or fall together and no held source ends either.
savings_check: The order has no savings, transition or accrued-rights clause, and none is needed to carry a consequence: no ending is claimed.
